subject: Narwell Caravan
fact: The Narwell Caravan was hired by the merchants of Narwell to escort a small merchant caravan into the Gnarley Forest.
source_quote: The Narwell Caravan: Hired by the merchants of Narwell, the party escorted a small merchant caravan into the Gnarley Forest

subject: Gnarley Forest

subject: ogre
